content.comment_body: Hello, According to the [product_name] manual: A data log file on the micro SD card can store up to 20,000 lines. [product_name] automatically creates a new file after it reaches 20,000 lines. A micro SD card can store up to 50 data log files for each [product_name] base module. Only the latest data log file on the micro SD card can be uploaded from [product_name] to [product_name]Soft Comfort. My question: If the SD card has up to 50 CSV files, can these files be read directly from a PC instead of uploading via [product_name]Soft Comfort? Regards,

Using the "Upload Data Log" feature, only [product_name]Soft Comfort can read the latest data log uploaded from [product_name]. To access all CSV files, you must remove the micro SD card from the [product_name] and read them with your PC.

Hello, Has this procedure changed since the original post? I am struggling with the 20,000 line limitation, because how do I know when to retrieve the file to avoid data loss? Alternatively, is it possible to start a new file right after downloading one? I understand that switching between stop and run modes does not create a new file. So, does that mean performing a program update or reload is the only way to start a new file? With 1-minute intervals, this limit gives me a maximum of 13.8 days before reaching 20,000 lines.

If there is space on the SD card, [product_name] automatically creates a new log file once the first one is full. Regarding the 13.8 days calculation, is there a need to expect a different value? Data loss will occur eventually. To read the log files, you need to stop the [product_name], remove the SD card, copy the files to a PC, delete the files, reinsert the SD card, and restart the [product_name]. During this time, logging is interrupted.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants desire easier access to and management of log files stored on micro SD cards for [product_name] base modules, highlighting limitations in only retrieving the latest log through [product_name]Soft Comfort. Frustration arises over potential data loss due to the automatic file rollover after 20,000 lines. The necessity to stop logging during manual SD card handling is identified as a significant issue.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect direct access to all CSV log files from a PC without lengthy procedures or concerns about losing data. They seek flexible control over file generation to avoid accidental overwrites.
